issues.description: The solution repository changes the visibility of PersonService.addParent from public (as declared in the template and required by the REST layer and tests) to private. The problem statement and template expect addParent to be a public service method that can be invoked by PersonResource and by tests. Making it private prevents PersonResource and tests from calling it and would cause compilation errors or unexpected behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Restore a public visibility for addParent in PersonService (public Person addParent(Person person, Person parent)) so it matches the template and problem statement and is callable from PersonResource and tests. Ensure the method signature and visibility of any other related methods (addChild, removeParent, removeChild) remain consistent between template, tests, and REST layer.
